news.title: From spin wave to superconducting circuit: A one-way street for quantum information
news.summary_en: A collaboration between Argonne and the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign builds the first hybrid circuit system between propagating spin waves in magnetic materials and a superconducting circuit.

news.title: “Carpet” growth method yields long-sought 2D quantum material
news.summary_en: A new approach to growing a thin sheet of bismuth telluride let UChicago PME researchers confirm its ability to form a 2D topological insulator at ambient conditions.
